name: Sydilix Initiation
summary: Sydilix initiation is a high-octane 2d platformer game where you play as a martial artist who has had an extremely bad childhood and he is on a mission to save the world from getting destroyed by a purple devil, by going inside a tv and going through various tv worlds so he can find the purple devil and defeat him so he doesn't press the button he was inventing that destroys the world.
